name: Power MAX

features.text: Fast and efficient dirt and grease remover.
Contains no abrasives to damage the surface.

description: The ultimate all-purpose cleaner for vehicle interior surfaces such as vinyl, upholstery, carpet, plastic, and leather. Power Max™ removes the toughest stains and grime, leaving behind a pleasant scent.
application: Always test diluted product for spotting or damage on an inconspicuous area before using on an entire surface. Dilution: Always dilute with at least 9 parts water to 1 part product. Use only in diluted form 1) Spray or wipe diluted solution onto surface to be cleaned. 2) Scrub with upholstery brush, if needed. 3) wipe dry with a clean towel. Note: Can be used in carpet extractor machines
